headline: Procurement Manager
summary: Procurement manager with ten years in food manufacturing and agribusiness in Davao. I lead a team of six buyers, source raw materials and packaging from local and foreign suppliers, and negotiate contracts that protect both cost and supply. I keep procurement compliant with company policy and audit requirements.

experience.title: Procurement Manager
bullets: Lead six buyers purchasing about ₱900 million a year of fruit, sugar, packaging and spare parts.
Negotiated two-year packaging contracts that held prices flat through a year of 15% resin increases.
Built a supplier scorecard for quality, delivery and price, reviewed with suppliers every quarter.
Review every contract with legal for compliance with the company's purchasing policy.

experience.title: Senior Buyer
bullets: Sourced fertiliser, chemicals and farm equipment for 3,000 hectares of plantations.
Tracked commodity prices and advised management on the best times to buy.

education.credential: Bachelor of Science in Industrial Engineering
education.school: Davao Institute of Engineering and Technology
